title: selfcheck fails allow-rules and hooks in a host project, on the kb's glab, core.hooksPath and .claude-plugin checks (second-project run)
goal: selfcheck in a host project (a root that is not the plugin's own checkout) runs only the checks whose inputs the project names: allow-rules requires the sprint loop's git commands, tools and backlog.py commands plus the commands its backlog.json names (land_push, land_stale, land_eval, land_lint), and the forge's glab or gh command only when backlog.json sets forge, never the kb's kbgit.py, tests.py, check.py, rag.py, selfdoc.py or lint.py ones; a host with no .claude/settings.json reads unknown, not FAIL; hooks is skipped, said so, unless core.hooksPath is set, then it needs only that path to exist; the plugin manifest is checked in the plugin's own checkout only; in the kb's own checkout every check runs as today

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,'.claude')); json.dump({'permissions':{'allow':['Bash(git *)','Bash(python3 *backlog.py *)','Agent','SendMessage','Edit','Write']}},open(os.path.join(d,'.claude','settings.json'),'w')); json.dump({'land_push':['git','push','origin','HEAD:main']},open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w')); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'selfcheck'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; bad=[l[:90] for l in o.splitlines() if l.startswith(('FAIL hooks','FAIL allow-rules'))]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_selfcheck as s; sys.exit(0 if s.check_allow('.')['state']=='ok' and s.plugin_problem('.') is None else 1)

import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,'.claude')); json.dump({'permissions':{'allow':['Bash(git *)','Bash(python3 *backlog.py *)','Agent','SendMessage','Edit','Write']}},open(os.path.join(d,'.claude','settings.json'),'w')); json.dump({'land_stale':['_tools/selfdoc.py','stale','--since']},open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w')); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'selfcheck'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(0 if 'FAIL allow-rules' in o else 1)

import subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'selfcheck'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(1 if 'FAIL allow-rules' in o else 0)

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,'myhooks')); subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'config','core.hooksPath','myhooks']); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'selfcheck'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(1 if 'FAIL hooks' in o else 0)

gates.question: Which checks does selfcheck run in a host project?
options: only checks whose inputs the host names: forge commands when its forge and land_push name them, hooks when it sets a hooks path, the plugin manifest in the kb only
all checks, with a selfcheck_skip list in the host backlog.json
gates.recommendation: only checks whose inputs the host names: forge commands when its forge and land_push name them, hooks when it sets a hooks path, the plugin manifest in the kb only
gates.answer: only checks whose inputs the host names: forge commands when its forge and land_push name them, hooks when it sets a hooks path, the plugin manifest in the kb only

notes: Run finding 6: in a host, selfcheck printed FAIL allow-rules (glab mr view, git worktree add, tool Agent) and FAIL hooks (core.hooksPath not set; .claude-plugin/plugin.json missing). Blocks the Nerthus adoption (BG-42dg5ryi's host); P1 by the operator. Planned to the operator's answer: only checks whose inputs the host names. Ran the filed repro (git-init project, no settings): FAIL allow-rules (.claude/settings.json is missing) and FAIL hooks (core.hooksPath is not set; .claude-plugin/plugin.json is missing), the stated defect. Rewritten to plant settings that allow git, backlog.py, Agent, SendMessage, Edit and Write and a backlog.json naming land_push: it still fails, FAIL allow-rules: 9 of 31 not covered: python3 _tools/kbgit.py sync --push, plus FAIL hooks. Ran the checks now: kb guard passes (check_allow('.') ok, plugin_problem('.') None), named-command guard passes, no-settings and hooks-path checks fail. Fix is in bl_selfcheck.py: SKILL_COMMANDS (line 12) split into the loop's own and the kb's, gated by land_push, land_stale, land_eval, land_lint and forge from setting() (source file only for forge); read_allow (missing settings: unknown for a host); hooks_problem (line 224) and plugin_problem (line 245) behind check_hooks (line 259). Referrers of SKILL_COMMANDS: backlog.md:373, tools.md:104 (selfcheck rows). Where the root is the plugin's own checkout is for the worker to define (the root holds _tools/kbgit.py); the loop's backlog.py commands are matched with any path before _tools/backlog.py.
